# Load the libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
# library(paletteer)

# This is the data with the annotated and predicted values (with annotation, visible lipid sac, no visible lipid sac). So make sure to curate first and that an object_id is only considered once. This file also contains a table of the annotated data, and the original list of UVP6 metadata with morphological descriptors (including the images excluded because outside the size range).
load("data/uvp6_lipids_20250407.RData")

theme_set(theme_bw())
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

# Curate the lipid segmentation data
```{r}
uvp6 <- uvp6_all %>% 
  # remove the predictions for images with manually annotated data
  filter(type != "predicted") %>% 
  # # include the metadata for images segmented but excluded?
  # bind_rows(uvp6_meta %>% 
  #             filter(object_id %notin% uvp6_all$object_id)) %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(date),
         Month = month(date),
         DOY = yday(date))

# Make sure that an image is not considered twice. This has to match number of rows 
length(unique(uvp6$object_id)) == nrow(uvp6)

# TODO calculate the biovolume, dry weight, prosome and lipid mass in carbon, and lipid fullness in carbon

AA <- uvp6_all %>% 
  filter(type == "not visible")


```


# Exploring vertical profiles
## Overall number of images in 100 m depth bins
```{r}
# For all "valid" uvp6 Calanus images with segmentations

binsize <-  100
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6 %>%
  
  filter(type != "predicted")  %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(depth/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = as.factor(depthBin)) %>% 
  select(depthRange, depthBin, prosome, lipid, lipidfullness, Major) %>% 
  group_by(depthRange, depthBin) %>%  
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = mean, 
                                           sd = sd, 
                                           n = ~sum(!is.na(.)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(depthBin)
# Set range to factors
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6_allBin %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                                levels = unique(uvp6_allBin$depthRange)))

# add cummulative number and percent of images
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6_allBin %>% 
  mutate(percent = lipid_n / sum(lipid_n) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(cumtotal = cumsum(lipid_n),
         cumpercent = cumsum(percent)) %>% 
  mutate(cumpercentRev = 100 - cumpercent)


cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = depthRange, 
                          x = lipid_n)) +
    geom_point() +
    xlab("N images") + ylab("Depth bin") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev),
  
  ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = depthRange, 
                          x = cumpercent)) +
    geom_point() +
    xlab("% images") + ylab("Depth bin") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev),
  labels = "auto"
)
```

# Spatial sampling distribution
For plotting depth as contours instead:
basemap(limits = c(0, 60, 68, 80), bathymetry = TRUE, bathy.style = "contour_blues") + 
  scale_color_hue()
```{r}
library(ggOceanMaps)

df <- distinct(uvp6, sample_id, lon, lat, Year, Month, DOY) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year))

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = TRUE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-90,-50,65,83), rotate = 10,
        legends = TRUE,
        land.border.col = NA, gla.border.col = NA,
        data = df) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                               shape = Year, color = DOY),
             size = 3) +
  # scale_color_continuous() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "yellow3", high = "red", na.value = NA) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24)) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())


basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = TRUE, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-90,-50,65,83), rotate = 10,
        legends = TRUE,
        data = df,bathy.style = "contour_blues") +
  scale_color_hue() +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                               shape = Year, fill = DOY),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "yellow3", high = "red", na.value = NA) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24)) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())


# Check location of potential UVP5 data (calanoida images)
uvp5_ge_side <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP5_greenedge/ecotaxa_export_149_20241018_1551.tsv", sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
uvp5_ge_top <- read.table("../../Laval-imaging-analysis/UVP5_greenedge/ecotaxa_export_149_20241018_1553.tsv", sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
uvp5_ge <- bind_rows(uvp5_ge_side, uvp5_ge_top)
rm(uvp5_ge_side, uvp5_ge_top)

df_uvp5 <- uvp5_ge %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, lon = object_lon, lat = object_lat,
           botdep = sample_bottomdepth, date = object_date) %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(date),
         Month = month(date),
         DOY = yday(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year))

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = TRUE, glaciers = TRUE,
        limits = c(-65,-55,67,71), rotate = TRUE,
        legends = TRUE,
        data = df_uvp5) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df_uvp5, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                                    color = DOY),
             size = 3, shape = 22) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "yellow3", high = "red", na.value = NA) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24)) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())

```


# Individual vertical profiles plot
```{r}
binsize <-  100
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6 %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(depth/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = as.factor(depthBin)) %>% 
  select(Month, sample_id, depthBin, prosome, lipid, lipidfullness) %>% 
  group_by(Month, sample_id, depthBin) %>%  
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = mean, 
                                           sd = sd, 
                                           n = ~sum(!is.na(.)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(depthBin2 = as.numeric(depthBin)) 
  

ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = prosome_n,
                        x = depthBin2, 
                        color = sample_id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  # geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Depth Bin", y = "Number of images") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = unique(uvp6_allBin$depthBin2),
                  labels = levels(uvp6_allBin$depthBin)) +
  facet_wrap(~Month, scales = "free_x")

# Isolate the 15 profiles for samples with deep bottom depths > 1000m
uvp6_allBin2 <- uvp6_allBin %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(maxdep = max(depthBin2)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(maxdep >= 11)


ggplot(uvp6_allBin2, aes(y = prosome_n,
                        x = depthBin2, 
                        color = sample_id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Depth Bin", y = "Number of images") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = unique(uvp6_allBin$depthBin2),
                  labels = levels(uvp6_allBin$depthBin)) +
  ggtitle("Profiles beyond 1000 m") 



df <- uvp6 %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(maxdep = max(depth)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(maxdep >= 1000) %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, lon, lat, Year, Month, DOY, maxdep) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year))

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = TRUE, glaciers = TRUE,
        limits = c(-90,-50,65,83), rotate = TRUE,
        legends = TRUE,
        data = df) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
                                               shape = Year, color = DOY),
             size = 3) +
  # scale_color_continuous() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "yellow3", high = "red", na.value = NA) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 24)) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())  +
  ggtitle("Profiles beyond 1000 m") 
```

# TODO Plot proportion of images with segmentations relative to total living zoop images and total copepod images
```{r}
# The uvp6 data from ecotaxa
load("data/uvp6_deam_living_20250320.RData")

# Merge the 2021 an 2023 data 
uvp6_ecotaxa <- bind_rows(uvp6_de, uvp6_am) 
rm(uvp6_de, uvp6_am, uvp6_ecopart)

# Metadata of samples
meta_uvp6 <- uvp6_ecotaxa %>% 
  distinct(sample_id, lon = object_lon, lat = object_lat,
           botdep = sample_bottomdepth, date = object_date) %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(date),
         Month = month(date),
         DOY = yday(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year)) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>% 
  ungroup() 

# Get abundance
abund <- uvp6_ecotaxa %>%
  # separate copepods to with or without segmentations
  mutate(taxagroup = if_else(object_id %in% uvp6$object_id,
                              "Copepoda_segmented", taxagroup)) %>% 
  rename(lon = object_lon, lat = object_lat, 
         date = object_date, depth = object_depth_min,
         volume_m3 = Sampled_volume_m3) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, lon, lat, Depth_5m, volume_m3, taxagroup) %>% 
  summarise(nimgs = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundance = nimgs/volume_m3)

# # Check if all copepod with segmentation images are accounted for
# ii <- uvp6_ecotaxa %>% 
#   filter(object_id %in% uvp6_all$object_id)
# jj <- uvp6_all %>% 
#   filter(object_id %notin% uvp6_ecotaxa$object_id)


# To get abundance at other bin sizes, need to full join ?the volume data in uvp6_volumes so it records the bins with zero abundance. Easier if the ecopart data is pre binned
binsize <-  100
uvp6_ecopartBin <- uvp6_volumes %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  summarise(volume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            nbins = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(binsize = binsize)

# integrated to 50 m depth bins [must sum individuals and divide by volume BUT including zero abundances], not just average

abundBin <- abund %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(Depth_5m/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  select(-c(Depth_5m, volume_m3, abundance)) %>% 
  left_join(uvp6_ecopartBin %>% select(-nbins),
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, lon, lat, depthBin, taxagroup, binsize, volume_m3) %>% 
  summarise(nimgsBin = sum(nimgs),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(abundanceBin = nimgsBin / volume_m3)
  
# Total abundance and copepod fraction
abundBinTotal <- abundBin %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, lon, lat, depthBin, binsize) %>% 
  summarise(abundanceTotal = sum(abundanceBin), 
            nimgsTotal = sum(nimgsBin),
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  # Copepod with segmentation fraction of abundance
  left_join(abundBin %>% 
              filter(taxagroup == "Copepoda_segmented") %>% 
              select(sample_id, depthBin, abundCope = abundanceBin),
            by = join_by(sample_id, depthBin)) %>% 
  mutate(copepod_frac = abundCope/abundanceTotal) %>% 
  mutate(copepod_frac = if_else(is.na(copepod_frac),
                                0, copepod_frac))


ggplot(abundBinTotal, aes(y = abundanceTotal, x = depthBin,
                          fill = copepod_frac)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = sample_id), alpha = 0.4)+
  geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  guides(color="none")


ggplot(abundBinTotal, aes(y = copepod_frac, x = depthBin)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  coord_flip() +
  ylab("Proporiton of images with segmentations") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  guides(color="none")
```

## Community composition 
```{r}
# Overall average per month
abundBin2 <- abundBin %>% # abundance by taxa group
  group_by(sample_id, depthBin) %>% 
  mutate(abundanceTotal = sum(abundanceBin), 
          nimgsTotal = sum(nimgsBin)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # calculate proportion of taxa group to total abundance
  mutate(percAbund = abundanceBin / abundanceTotal * 100) %>% 
  left_join(meta_uvp6 %>% 
              select(sample_id, Year, Month, DOY) %>% 
              distinct(),
            by = "sample_id")

# Average all profiles collected in the same month
abundBin3 <- abundBin2 %>% 
  group_by(taxagroup, Year, Month, depthBin, binsize) %>% 
  summarise(abundanceMean = mean(abundanceBin),
            abundnaceSD = sd(abundanceBin),
            nsamples = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot(abundBin3, aes(x = depthBin, y = abundanceMean, fill = taxagroup)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + #position = "fill"
  coord_flip() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = paletteer::paletteer_d("ggsci::default_ucscgb", n = 19)) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  facet_wrap(~Month)

# recount number of copepoda with segmentations per depth bin

# Proportion copepoda (with and without segmentations), crustaceans, others 
abundBin4 <- abundBin2 %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup2 = if_else(taxagroup %in% c("Copepoda", "Copepoda_segmented"),
                              taxagroup, "Other Mesozoop")) %>% 
  group_by(taxagroup2, sample_id, Year, Month, depthBin, binsize) %>% 
  summarise(abundanceBin = sum(abundanceBin),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(taxagroup2, Year, Month, depthBin, binsize) %>% 
  summarise(abundanceMean = mean(abundanceBin),
            abundnaceSD = sd(abundanceBin),
            nsamples = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(taxagroup2 = factor(taxagroup2,
                             levels = c("Other Mesozoop","Copepoda",
                                        "Copepoda_segmented")))

# clrs <- paletteer_d("colorBlindness::paletteMartin", n = 19)
clrs <- c("hotpink","gold2","black")

cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(abundBin4, aes(x = depthBin, y = abundanceMean, fill = taxagroup2)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") + #position = "fill"
    coord_flip() + 
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) +
    ylab("mean abundance (indivs  m-3)") + xlab("depth (m)") +
    facet_wrap(~Month, scales = "free_x") +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),
  
  ggplot(abundBin4, aes(x = depthBin, y = abundanceMean, fill = taxagroup2)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") + 
    coord_flip() + 
    scale_x_reverse() +
    facet_wrap(~Month) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = clrs) +
    ylab("mean abundance (indivs  m-3)") + xlab("depth (m)") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom"),
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1,1.2)
)
```
